DEFENSE BAY 03
LAUNCH AUTHORITY VERIFIED
DEFENSE INHIBIT REJECTED
EMERGENCY LAW STILL ACTIVE
CUSTODIAN FRAME DEPLOYING<New><Elly>
"I can't believe this robot
is still operational after
all this time..."<New><Elly>
"The Custodian Core must have
transferred into it. It is
guarding our Gears."<New><Elly>
"The code opened the bay, but
it still considers us
intruders. Board quickly.
Keep launch control intact."<New><Emeralda>
"Then Emeralda shuts down
very old robot!"<Close>

CUSTODIAN CORE OFFLINE
DEFENSE LOOP ENDED
LAUNCH AUTHORIZATION ACTIVE
WEST BULKHEAD UNLOCKED<New><Emeralda>
"Old robot finally stopped!"<New><Elly>
"The defense loop has ended.
The lift will carry us back
to the archive. Then we can
use the west bulkhead."<Close>

DEFENSE BAY ACCESS DENIED
LAUNCH AUTHORITY NOT FOUND<New>Return to the archive above
and complete authorization
at the wall console.<Close>
